# PRD Quality Checklist

Use this checklist before considering planning docs ready.

## Structure

- [ ] Project folder uses `src/<project-slug>/` format.
- [ ] All standard files exist (`00` to `05`).
- [ ] Section headings are clear and scannable.

## Requirement Quality

- [ ] Functional requirements have `FR-*` IDs.
- [ ] Non-functional requirements have `NFR-*` IDs.
- [ ] Requirements are specific and testable.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are measurable.

## Traceability

- [ ] Roadmap items map to requirement IDs.
- [ ] Task breakdown items map to requirement IDs.
- [ ] Risks reference affected milestones or requirements.

## Planning Readiness

- [ ] Dependencies are listed with owners.
- [ ] Assumptions and open questions are explicit.
- [ ] Decision log captures major trade-offs.
- [ ] Next actions are concrete and prioritized.
